# Juice

> Juice is an anonymous, men-only social platform for sharing and reading honest dating reviews. Verified men post structured reviews using codenames and a 4-metric rating system (Communication, Loyalty, Emotional Safety, Overall Vibe).

Juice uses manual user approval (no invite codes), never retains phone numbers after approval, and has no location features. Juice is not distributed through app stores: it runs in the browser at sipjuice.app as an installable web app (Add to Home Screen), with native iOS/Android builds in development via Capacitor.
